spans.s:
ए 1. ए, the eleventh vowel of the alphabet,
corresponding to the letter ए as pronounced in most
languages, and having the sound of ए in प्रेय्, ग्रेय्.
In English, however, this sound is rarely given to ए.
—ए-कार, अस्, m. the letter or sound ए.

ए 2. ए, ind. an interjection of remembering,
addressing, censure or contempt, and compassion.
ए 3. ए, एस्, m. a N. of Viṣṇu.
